name: Cherethites
description: A military group in the Old Testament

points: David set his officers: Joab over the host; Jehoshaphat the recorder; Zadok and Ahimelech the priests; Seraiah the scribe; Benaiah over the Cherethites and Pelethites; and David's sons were chief rulers.

Joab was over all the host of Israel, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada over the Cherethites and the Pelethites. Adoram was over the tribute, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder, and Sheva was scribe.
In the seventh year Jehoiada the priest brought the captains together, took an oath of them in the house of the Most High, and showed them the king's son.

note.label: 2 Kings 11: The Hidden King and the Covenant to Be the Lord's People
